description: Proteome-scale benchmark: ANXA2R's membrane-anchor metrics against reviewed human single-pass type I membrane proteins and cytoplasmic proteins, plus N-glycosylation sequon analysis
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re, json, os
from scipy import stats
OUT="/agent/jobs/c66b88c8-ca85-4b2f-8912-236606c1f8b3/provenance"

HESSA={'A':0.11,'C':-0.13,'D':3.49,'E':2.68,'F':-0.32,'G':0.74,'H':2.06,'I':-0.60,'K':2.71,'L':-0.55,'M':-0.10,
       'N':2.05,'P':2.23,'Q':2.36,'R':2.58,'S':0.84,'T':0.52,'V':-0.31,'W':0.30,'Y':0.68}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,
    'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def stats_for(s):
    s="".join(c for c in s if c in HESSA)
    if len(s)<30: return None
    w=19
    dg=min(sum(HESSA[a] for a in s[i:i+w]) for i in range(len(s)-w+1))
    kd=max(np.mean([KD[a] for a in s[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(s)-w+1))
    return dg,kd,len(s)

def uniprot_set(query,size=200):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
        params={"query":query,"format":"fasta","size":size},timeout=300)
    r.raise_for_status()
    seqs={}; acc=None; buf=[]
    for line in r.text.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith(">"):
            if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
            acc=line.split("|")[1]; buf=[]
        elif line.strip(): buf.append(line.strip())
    if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
    return seqs

sets={
 "single-pass type I membrane\n(SwissProt human, reviewed)":
   'organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true AND cc_scl_term:SL-9905 AND ft_topo_dom:* AND keyword:KW-0812 AND existence:1 AND length:[150 TO 500]',
 "cytoplasm, no membrane keyword\n(SwissProt human, reviewed)":
   'organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true AND cc_scl_term:SL-0091 AND NOT keyword:KW-0472 AND NOT keyword:KW-0812 AND existence:1 AND length:[150 TO 500]',
}
res={}
for lab,q in sets.items():
    try:
        seqs=uniprot_set(q)
        vals=[stats_for(s) for s in seqs.values()]
        vals=[v for v in vals if v]
        res[lab]=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=["min_dG19","max_KD19","len"])
        print(f"{lab.splitlines()[0]:45s} n={len(vals)}  median dG {res[lab]['min_dG19'].median():+.2f}  median KD {res[lab]['max_KD19'].median():.2f}")
    except Exception as ex:
        print("FAILED", lab, repr(ex))

ANX_DG, ANX_KD = 3.68, 1.54
print("\nANXA2R: min_dG19 = %+.2f, max_KD19 = %.2f" % (ANX_DG, ANX_KD))
rows=[]
for lab,df in res.items():
    pdg = float((df["min_dG19"] <= ANX_DG).mean())
    pkd = float((df["max_KD19"] >= ANX_KD).mean())
    z   = float((ANX_DG - df["min_dG19"].mean())/df["min_dG19"].std())
    rows.append((lab.replace("\n"," "), len(df), round(df["min_dG19"].median(),2), round(df["max_KD19"].median(),2),
                 round(pdg,4), round(pkd,4), round(z,2)))
    print(f"  vs {lab.splitlines()[0]:42s}: {100*pdg:5.1f}% of set has dG <= ANXA2R;  {100*pkd:5.1f}% has KD >= ANXA2R;  z(dG) = {z:+.2f}")
mw = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["reference_set","n","median_min_dG19","median_max_KD19",
                                 "frac_set_dG_le_ANXA2R","frac_set_KD_ge_ANXA2R","z_score_dG"])
mw.to_csv(f"{OUT}/anxa2r_proteome_scale_benchmark.csv",index=False)

# Mann-Whitney between the two reference sets, as a sanity check that the metric separates them
k=list(res)
u,p = stats.mannwhitneyu(res[k[0]]["min_dG19"], res[k[1]]["min_dG19"], alternative="less")
print(f"\nSanity check, Mann-Whitney U on min_dG19 (type I membrane < cytoplasmic): U={u:.0f}, p={p:.3g}")
print("  rank-biserial effect size r =", round(1 - 2*u/(len(res[k[0]])*len(res[k[1]])),3))

# ---------- N-glycosylation sequons, a hallmark of a receptor ectodomain ----------
S=("MEQHFLGCVKRAWDSAEVAPEPQPPPIVSSEDRGPWPLPLYPVLGEYSLDSCDLGLLSSPCWRLPGVYWQNGLSPGVQSTLEPSTAKPTEFSWPGTQKQQEAPVEEVGQAEEPDRLRLQQ"
   "LPWSSPLHPWDRQQDTEVCDSGCLLERRHPPALQPWRHLPGFSDCLEWILRVGFAAFSVLWACCSRICGAKQP")
seq=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=N[^P][ST])',S)]
print("\nN-X-S/T sequons in ANXA2R:", seq if seq else "NONE (the protein contains only 1 Asn, at position 72)")
print("  Asn count:", S.count("N"), "| predicted MW 21.7 kDa vs the 26 kDa band reported in PMID 16895901")
print("  A glycosylated type I receptor ectodomain almost always carries >=1 sequon; ANXA2R has none,")
print("  so the 21.7 -> 26 kDa gel-mobility gap is not explained by N-glycosylation.")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
cols=["#2b6cb0","#718096"]
for (lab,df),c in zip(res.items(),cols):
    ax.hist(df["min_dG19"],bins=40,alpha=.55,label=f"{lab} (n={len(df)})",color=c)
ax.axvline(ANX_DG,color="#c53030",lw=2.5)
ax.text(ANX_DG+0.2,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,"ANXA2R\n+3.68",color="#c53030",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("most favourable 19-aa dG(app) of translocon insertion (kcal/mol)")
ax.set_ylabel("proteins"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("ANXA2R falls inside the cytoplasmic distribution",fontsize=11)

ax=axes[1]
for (lab,df),c in zip(res.items(),cols):
    ax.scatter(df["max_KD19"],df["min_dG19"],s=9,alpha=.45,color=c,label=lab)
ax.scatter([ANX_KD],[ANX_DG],s=160,marker="*",color="#c53030",zorder=5,label="ANXA2R Q3ZCQ2")
ax.set_xlabel("max Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)"); ax.set_ylabel("min dG(app) 19-aa (kcal/mol)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title("Proteome-scale separation of the two classes",fontsize=11)
fig.suptitle("Proteome-scale test: does ANXA2R carry a membrane anchor?",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
